digest.component_or_area: completion verifier and banking policy enforcement
propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion verifier runs exhaust their bounded request budget with zero incrementally banked criterion verdicts instead of returning evidence-backed PASS/FAIL outcomes.

Pydantic AI executes tool batches from a single model response concurrently, allowing tool calls to execute in parallel even when the banking contract requires serialized evidence collection and commit ordering.
Prompt-only instructions cannot enforce one governed repository action per response; the enforcement boundary must be explicit at the tool-wrapper composition layer.

The completion tool policy wrapper atomically claims one governed action per run step, counts unique evidence responses for the current unbanked criterion, and invokes automatic provisional met=false banking on the third evidence response if still unbanked.

The policy wrapper is composed between memo toolsets and runaway guard, intercepting parallel repository calls and preventing execution before memo or real tool invocation while preserving live per-criterion progress tracking.
